{{Quote|The jewels used to fabricate this piece are valuable but not unusual. These could have been acquired on a variety of worlds at any time in the last several centuries. But the technique...definitely Vilivian. His workshop, maybe his own hand.|Mulus Cheems to Kosh Teradoc|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Vilivian''' was a [[Hapan]] [[gemwright]] who was famous for his intricately fitted gems held a brief but influential value several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] ago. Financial records indicated that he had made several sales to [[Piethet Brighteyes]].<ref name="MK" />
